tools.name: get_started
tools.description: Free, no auth. Service overview, pricing, current account status, and how to get an API key for the data tools.

tools.name: instagram_search
tools.description: Search Instagram users, hashtags, and places by keyword. Costs 1 credit. Requires Authorization: Bearer sk_instapi_... on the MCP connection.

tools.name: instagram_user_profile
tools.description: Public profile for an Instagram username: bio, links, follower/following/post counts, verified/private/business flags, category. Works for private accounts too. Costs 1 credit (refunded if the user doesn't exist). Requires Authorization: Bearer sk_instapi_....

tools.name: instagram_user_posts
tools.description: Fetch recent posts for an Instagram username, with images and videos AI-parsed into text descriptions. Costs 1 credit. Requires Authorization: Bearer sk_instapi_.... First fetch for a user can take up to ~60s while media is analyzed; cached users return fast.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "instagram_search" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "instagram_user_posts" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Fetch recent posts for an Instagram username, with images and videos AI-parsed into text descriptions. Costs 1 credit. Requires Authorization: Bearer sk_instapi…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: instagram_user_posts · Private data: get_started, instagram_user_profile · Public sink: instagram_user_profile.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: instagram_user_posts · Private data: get_started, instagram_user_profile · Public sink: instagram_user_profile

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
